public_mouths.name: SaturationMonoid.PhysicsCore.Stage10.Bell.ReadoutIdentification.rank_one_scale
public_mouths.type:
∀ {I J : Type} (left : I → ℝ) (right : J → ℝ) (otherLeft : I → ℝ) (otherRight : J → ℝ) (i₀ : I) (j₀ : J),
  left i₀ * right j₀ ≠ 0 →
    (∀ (i : I) (j : J), otherLeft i * otherRight j = left i * right j) →
      otherLeft i₀ / left i₀ ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ (i : I), otherLeft i = otherLeft i₀ / left i₀ * left i) ∧
          ∀ (j : J), otherRight j = right j / (otherLeft i₀ / left i₀)
